newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Calcemento in 4 for 1 cap rise.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Calcemento in 4 for 1 cap rise.

text.p: Italy's Calcemento said it will go ahead with a capital increase via the issue of 150.5 million ordinary shares at a nominal 1,000 lire on the basis of four new shares for each one held at a price of 1,500 lire.

Each new share will carry a warrant to be exercised by January 12, 1999 to subscribe for ordinary shares at the 1,000 lire nominal value on the basis of one share per warrant, Calcemento said in a statement following a board meeting.
The company, part of the industrial holding Compart, said it expected to raise 225.7 billion lire by the end of this year and up to a further 150.5 billion lire by end-1998.
The revenue will be used to reduce group debt, which totalled 851 billion lire following the sale of its Calcestruzzi unit to Italcementi ITAI.MI, which was finalised on Thursday.
Compart postponed the planned capital increase in May because it said at the time it wanted to be more certain of concluding the contract to sell Calcestruzzi.
